labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > allows deeply nested aliased actions
labels.note: Checks that a two-level alias resolves to the permitted action.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > allows to perform specified actions on target type (class)
labels.note: Checks both the class and its instances with exact boolean results.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > disallows to perform unspecified action on target
labels.note: Checks that the result is false for both the subject type and an instance.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > allows to perform action if target type matches at least 1 rule with or without conditions
labels.note: Checks an exact true result for the subject-type check.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > allows to perform action if target instance matches conditions
labels.note: Checks an exact true result for an instance that matches the conditions.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > `update` method and events > triggers "updated" event after rules have been updated
labels.note: Checks the exact event payload; for an event test this is the right check.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > `update` method and events > can unregister itself inside event handler
labels.note: Never checks that the unsubscribed handler stops firing on a later update.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > by default > `update` method and events > can unregister another event handler inside own handler
labels.note: Checks the exact handler call order before and after unsubscribing.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > rule precedence > checks rules in inverse order
labels.note: Checks both the case where the later cannot rule overrides and where it does not apply.

labels.id: casl/spec/ability.spec.ts::Ability > rule precedence > shadows rule with conditions by the same rule without conditions
labels.note: Checks that an instance not matching the conditions is still allowed.
